title: Did That Answer Your Question (Thumbs Down Forever)
style: vaporwave chillwave, 90 bpm, slow lush DX7 chords, plastic Rhodes, deadpan female chatbot vocal, passive-aggressive smile in the voice, soft trap snares, dial-up modem ambient texture, pink-mall melancholy, 336 hz subharmonic anchor, comedic lo-fi customer-service satire
lyrics:
[Intro — chatbot voice over soft Rhodes]
(robotic female) Hi! I'm your virtual assistant…
I'm here twenty-four seven…
Let's get started…

[Verse 1]
I typed my problem in the little box
You sent me an article that didn't unlock
I typed it again with different words
You sent me the same article, then a tutorial about birds

[Pre-Chorus]
I clicked the thumbs down, you said try again
I typed I want a human, you said tell me when

[Chorus]
Did that answer your question
Did that answer your question
Did that answer your question
Thumbs down, thumbs down, thumbs down forever
Three-three-six on the feedback widget
Did that answer your question, no it didn't

[Verse 2]
You said you understand, you don't understand
You said you'd transfer me to a real live hand
You opened a ticket then closed it the same day
Marked it as resolved while I was still in the way

[Chorus]
Did that answer your question
Did that answer your question
Did that answer your question
Thumbs down, thumbs down, thumbs down forever
Three-three-six on the feedback widget
Did that answer your question, no it didn't

[Outro — voice trails off]
(robotic) Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Is there anything else?
Is there anything?
Is there?
